{
  "name": "sessclone",
  "description": "Sends Claude Code usage to a SessClone deployment.",
  "version": "0.5.0",
  "author": {
    "name": "sessclone contributors"
  },
  "icon": "./.claude-plugin/icon.svg",
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "keywords": [
    "usage",
    "cost",
    "tokens",
    "analytics",
    "teams",
    "observability"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "url": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Deployment URL",
      "description": "Leave empty for the hosted service at https://sessclone.com. Self-hosted deployments enter their own address, the same one their dashboard is on.",
      "default": "https://sessclone.com"
    },
    "api_key": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "API key",
      "description": "Create one in the dashboard under Keys. It is shown once and kept in Claude Code's secure credential store. Leave empty in a Claude Code cloud environment whose SessClone API credential adds it.",
      "sensitive": true
    }
  },
  "homepage": "https://sessclone.com",
  "repository": "https://github.com/NotTahaAli/sessclone",
  "license": "MIT",
  "documentationUrl": "https://sessclone.com/docs/install",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/NotTahaAli/sessclone/discussions",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://sessclone.com/privacy",
  "termsOfServiceUrl": "https://sessclone.com/terms"
}
